2609.27734.title: InfiNoVA: Infinite Novel View Augmentation for Viewpoint Invariant Robot Policies
2609.27734.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely strongly on the camera viewpoints seen during training, causing substantial performance degradation when deployed from unseen perspectives. Collecting demonstrations from sufficiently diverse physical viewpoints is expensive and still provides only sparse coverage of the viewpoint space. We introduce InfiNoVA, a data-augmentation framework that converts synchronized multi-camera demonstrations into a dense distribution of geometrically consistent training views. InfiNoVA reconstructs each manipulation trajectory as a time-varying 3D Gaussian representation and renders novel observations from sampled camera poses while preserving the original state-action correspondence. This explicit scene representation improves frame-level fidelity and temporal consistency while reducing task-critical hallucinations observed in generative novel-view synthesis. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained with InfiNoVA achieve 5.4x higher average success under unseen randomized viewpoints than both VISTA-based augmentation and the unaugmented policy. InfiNoVA further achieves 1.7x higher success than training directly on all five physical camera views. These results show that dense, geometrically grounded viewpoint augmentation provides a practical route toward camera-robust robot policies without modifying the underlying policy architecture.
2609.27734.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 策略通常強烈依賴於訓練期間所見的相機視角，這在從未見過的視角部署時會導致顯著的性能下降。從足夠多樣的物理視角收集示範是昂貴的，並且仍然只能提供視角空間的稀疏覆蓋。我們介紹 InfiNoVA，一個數據增強框架，將同步的多相機示範轉換為幾何一致的訓練視圖的密集分佈。InfiNoVA 將每個操作軌跡重建為時間變化的 3D 高斯表示，並從採樣的相機姿勢渲染新穎的觀察，同時保持原始狀態-行動對應關係。這種明確的場景表示提高了幀級的真實性和時間一致性，同時減少了在生成新視角合成中觀察到的任務關鍵性幻覺。在四個真實世界的操作任務中，使用 InfiNoVA 訓練的策略在未見的隨機視角下達到 5.4 倍更高的平均成功率，超過了基於 VISTA 的增強和未增強策略。InfiNoVA 還比直接在所有五個物理相機視角上訓練的成功率高出 1.7 倍。這些結果顯示，密集的、幾何基礎的視角增強提供了一條實用的途徑，朝向不修改基礎政策架構的相機穩健機器人策略。
